info.name: Get members with access to asset

params.name: business_id
params.description: Unique identifier of the requesting business.

params.name: asset_id
params.description: Unique identifier of a business asset.

params.name: bookmark
params.description: Cursor used to fetch the next page of items

params.name: page_size
params.description: Maximum number of items to include in a single page of the response. See documentation on Pagination for more information.

params.name: start_index
params.description: An index to start fetching the results from. Only the results starting from this index will be returned.

items.docs: Get all the members the requesting business has granted access to on the given asset.

params.name: business_id
params.description: Unique identifier of the requesting business.

params.name: assets_summary
params.description:
Include assets summary in the response if this is true.

The assets summary returns a dictionary representing a summary of the assets
for the business user ID, with information like the ad accounts and profiles
the user has permissions for and what those permissions are

params.name: business_roles
params.description: A list of business roles to filter the members by. Only members whose roles are in the specified roles will be returned.

params.name: member_ids
params.description: A list of business members ids separated by comma.

params.name: start_index
params.description: An index to start fetching the results from. Only the results starting from this index will be returned.

params.name: bookmark
params.description: Cursor used to fetch the next page of items

params.name: page_size
params.description: Maximum number of items to include in a single page of the response. See documentation on Pagination for more information.

items.docs:
Get all members of the specified business.
The return response will include the member's business_role and assets they have access to if assets_summary=TRUE

params.name: business_id
params.description: Business id

items.docs: Update a member's business role within the business.

params.name: business_id
params.description: Business id

items.docs: Terminate memberships between the specified members and your business.

info.name: Get assets assigned to a member

params.name: business_id
params.description: Unique identifier of the requesting business.

params.name: member_id
params.description: The member id to fetch assets for.

params.name: asset_type
params.description: A resource type to filter the assets by. Only assets of the specified type will be returned.

params.name: start_index
params.description: An index to start fetching the results from. Only the results starting from this index will be returned.

params.name: bookmark
params.description: Cursor used to fetch the next page of items

params.name: page_size
params.description: Maximum number of items to include in a single page of the response. See documentation on Pagination for more information.

items.docs:
Get assets on which you assigned asset permissions to the given member. Can be used to:
- get all assets, regardless of asset type or
- get assets of one asset type by using the asset_type query.
The return response will include the permissions the member has to that asset and the asset type.

params.name: business_id
params.description: Unique identifier of the requesting business.

items.docs:
Grant multiple members access to assets and/or update multiple member's exisiting permissions to an asset.
Note: Not all listed permissions are applicable to each asset type. For example, PROFILE_PUBLISHER would not be applicable to an asset of type AD_ACCOUNT. The permission level PROFILE_PUBLISHER is only available to an asset of the type PROFILE.

params.name: business_id
params.description: Unique identifier of the requesting business.

items.docs: Terminate multiple members' access to an asset.
